description: This file contains functions for resolving Discord usernames to user IDs, parsing and resolving Discord targets, and related helper functions, primarily used for messaging and directory lookup within a Discord integration module.

methods.name: resolveDiscordTarget
methods.description: Resolves a Discord username or ID to a MessagingTarget, performing directory lookup if necessary.

methods.name: parseAndResolveDiscordTarget
methods.description: Parses and resolves a Discord target, throwing an error if resolution fails.

methods.name: safeParseDiscordTarget
methods.description: Safely attempts to parse a Discord target without throwing errors.

methods.name: isExplicitUserLookup
methods.description: Determines if the input string explicitly indicates a user lookup based on patterns.

methods.name: isLikelyUsername
methods.description: Checks if the input string is likely a username rather than a user ID or channel.
